stops.name: Umbalfälle
stops.detail: The Umbal Falls are waterfalls of the upper reaches of the Isel (there also called Umbalbach) in the Umbal Valley west of Hinterbichl in the Hohe Tauern National Park in Austria. The falls were declared a natural monument in 1991.
